parts.description: Reference drawing — Freightliner air-manifold switch installation
parts.notes:
Daimler Trucks North America drawing: INSTL-SWITCHES, AIR PRESS., CC. Drawing reference, not an orderable part number.
Detail A: 21-port manifold, with blend-air system, FLX LHX.
Detail B: 21-port manifold, without blend-air system, FLX LHX and FLH.
Detail C: 22-port manifold, without blend-air system, FLX S-T and Coronado.
Detail D: 22-port manifold, without blend-air system, Columbia FLH Argosy.
Detail E: 22-port manifold, with blend-air system, FLX LHX.
Labels include stop-light switch, primary and secondary low-air-pressure warning switches, cruise-control/service-brake switch, parking-brake warning, parking-brake cutout, and ECA auto-neutral. Locations vary by manifold configuration. Small part-number callouts are not transcribed because this photo is not clear enough. Original photo: IMG_9707.jpeg.
